x: Les Stokell and Tom Carter have a most enthusiastic bunch of youngsters under their wings; it gladdened one's heart to see so much promising young talent in Belgrave vests. A most exciting Senior 100 yds. was won by the versatile Charlie Jones in the good time of 10·2; Ron Holtum and S.
Sylvan Deane won both the sprints in 10·5 and 22·8 and a now free from injury Gerry Leroy made a welcome comeback to win both second string sprints in 10·4 and 23·5 .

In the 200m. we were out of luck again when S.Deane, who clocked 22·7s. was also unable to qualify. However, Dave Carter joined the finalists with a workmanlike performance a provided us with a very valuable point.

Sylvan Deane (10·4) was narrowly beaten in his 100 yds. heat, being passed in the last ten yards in a blanket finish. The leading white-vested runner in the second heat of the 880 went by unrecognised as Belgravians cheered on Malcolm Robinson in the main bunch.

Mal Robinson,4:22.0 and John Thresher,4:24.5, scooped the points in the mile from a field of nearly thirty, while Dave Carter made it a double for himself with a 23.3 secs furlong dash; Sylvan Deane winning the other furlong event in a snappy 22.8 secs.

In a very close 100 yds finish Sylvan Deane was 4th in 10.5 secs; and to complete the picture Eric Smith was sixth in the 2 mile walk. The team was Peter Eldridge, Sylvan Deane, Charlie Jones and Ron Holtum,who showed a most welcome return to form in this race. An inch meant the difference between 1st and 2nd place in the Long Jump, where Dave Ansell (21'10") and Jim McGrath were squeezed out of their winner's medals.

Charlie Jones sped after Southgate and pulled to within two yards, but last stage officials insisted on drawn stations and a further muddle ensued. When Sylvan Deane at last got away it was too late to catch Southgate.

Charlie Jones was the star of this meeting, with his 12.2 victory in the 120 yards handicap. Off 1 yard, he surged past 1½ man Sylvan Deane a yard from the tape in a time equal to 10.2 for the hundred.
A much improved turn-out for this our first home match resulted in our scoring a convincing victory. Dave Carter scored a sprint double (10.5 and 23.2), his runners-up being S.
winners: southern 4x110 P.Eldridge, S.Deane, R.Holtum, D.Carter.
